question:
Choose the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

It may seem pretintious to say so but I cannot live without my essential articles.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pretintious"** is incorrectly spelt and is not a valid English word. (गलत वर्तनी)

 
 
• **Correct Word: Pretentious** means attempting to impress by affecting greater importance or merit than is actually possessed. (दिखावटी)

 
 
• **Example: **His **pretentious** attitude made him unpopular among his peers.
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Essential **(आवश्यक): Absolutely necessary; extremely important.

 
 
• **Example:** Water is **essential** for all forms of life.
 
 
 
• **Cannot **(नहीं कर सकता): Unable to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **She **cannot** attend the meeting due to a prior commitment.
 
 
 
• **Articles** (लेख): Items or objects, or pieces of writing.
 
 
• **Example:** The newspaper is full of interesting** articles.**
 
 

5a:Tc60,

The correct answer is Option 1)&
